rationale: auth/api-key.ts envApiKeyAuth(name, envVars: readonly string[]) is EnvAPIKeyAuth(name, envVars ...string): a readonly array parameter is a variadic tail (language mechanics).
api/google-shared.ts supportsGoogleStrictToolSampling(modelId) is the unexported Go function of the same name over the same model-id test; the Google stream path calls it to choose strict tool mode.
openai-codex-responses.ts closeOpenAICodexWebSocketSessions(sessionId?): the optional id is a variadic tail; no argument closes every session.
Both TypeScript overloads (KnownProvider and string) are one Go function over a string provider; the optional ProviderEnv is a nil-able map and an undefined result is a nil slice.
Both TypeScript overloads are one Go function over a string provider; the optional ProviderEnv is a nil-able map and an undefined result is the empty string.

providers/all.ts getAllBuiltinModels<TProvider extends BuiltinProvider>(provider): the generic provider type narrows the TypeScript result only; Go takes the provider id as a string and returns []AnyModel.
providers/all.ts getBuiltinClassifierModels<TProvider>(provider): the generic narrowing is TypeScript only; Go takes the provider id and returns []*ClassifierModel.
tui.ts compositeTuiLine(baseLine, overlayLine, startCol, overlayWidth, totalWidth): same five parameters and string result.

terminal-image.ts encodeKitty(base64Data, {columns, rows, imageId, moveCursor}): the four option fields are positional (columns, rows, imageID, optional moveCursor) and cover every upstream field; zero is the absent value and any other number is emitted, matching the truthiness guards at :234-237 (fixed in this change, test first).

terminal-image.ts encodeITerm2(base64Data, options): the ITerm2Options struct carries all five upstream fields (width, height, name, preserveAspectRatio, inline). The struct was added in this change, test first, because the positional form had no inline option.
terminal-image.ts getCellDimensions() returns the current CellDimensions; Go returns the same value type.
